Marketplace SCM login

1. API for opening the marketplace SCM page.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Admin/ScmLogin.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required user_id string Marketplace account ex) Auction ID : a2135
3. Required mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code APISHOP_mall0001.

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ScmInfo>
		<user_info>
			<customer_id>a0000001</customer_id>
			<user_id>nemosoft</user_id>
			<mall_id>APISHOP_0003</mall_id>
		</user_info>
	</ScmInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

Opens the marketplace seller page directly.
